name: uzfintech
description: Exact API contracts and implementation checklists for Uzbek payment providers: Uzum Bank (Merchant API, Checkout, Fiscalization, FastPay, Dynamic QR, CrossBorder, Remit Core, Ratekeeper, Nasiya, PaymentHub), Alif (alifpay), Click (SHOP API, Merchant API, card tokens, fiscalization, CLICK Pass, Telegram Payments), Paynet (Humo / Uzcard acquiring), Payme (Merchant API, Subscribe API, Checkout, fiscalization) and Multicard (invoices, card binding, payments, holds, payouts), with vendor sandbox test data.
